rationale: Placeholder fingerprint seeded DOM-only (all kinds ineligible). The Plan 02 Task 2 calibration harness (tests/e2e/calibration/calibration.harness.ts) regenerates this file with per-engine per-(fixture,variant,kind) eligibility, observed heightDriftP95, and breaksMatchRatio derived from the first full calibration run across Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. Until that run completes and commits a calibrated fingerprint, useMeasurement defaults to the safe DOM-only path (D3-03 fallback) — the engine measures via domMeasurer; no Pretext fast path is enabled.
